known_sdk_limitations: The genlayer CLI read path answers "gen_call does not exist" on this network's default RPC; reads were captured as raw gen_call on https://rpc-bradbury.genlayer.com with hand-encoded GenVM calldata. A page that reads this contract must read through deployment.json's rpc_url.

The CLI argument parser turns a decimal string such as 8453 into a number and a 0x... string into an address type; set_chain was written with the s# string-argument rule (a byte-copy of the CLI bundle with one added rule), see the tooling note in MEASURED-017.
The node's own gas figures are not available on rpc-bradbury, so no per-transaction gas is recorded.
